an10.99:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Upāli yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Upāli Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an10.99:1.2: ‘icchām' ahaṃ bhante araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevitun' ti. 2.
an10.99:2.1: Durabhisambhavāni kho Upāli araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni,
an10.99:2.3: ekatte, haranti maññe mano vanāni samādhiṃ alabhamānassa bhikkhuno.
an10.99:2.5: ‘ahaṃ samādhiṃ alabhamāno araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevissāmī' ti, tass' etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
an10.99:3.2: Atha āgaccheyya hatthināgo sattaratano vā aṭṭharatano vā.
an10.99:3.4: ‘yan nūnāhaṃ imaṃ udakarahadaṃ ogāhetvā kaṇṇasandhovikaṃ pi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷeyyaṃ, piṭṭhisandhovikaṃ pi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷeyyaṃ,
an10.99:3.5: kaṇṇasandhovikaṃ pi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷitvā piṭṭhisandhovikaṃ pi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷitvā nahātvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā yena kāmaṃ pakkameyyan' ti.
an10.99:3.6: So taṃ udakarahadaṃ ogāhetvā kaṇṇasandhovikaṃ pi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷeyya, piṭṭhisandhovikaṃ pi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷeyya,
an10.99:3.7: kaṇṇasandhovikaṃ pi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷitvā piṭṭhisandhovikaṃ pi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷitvā nahātvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā yena kāmaṃ pakkameyya.
an10.99:3.9: Mahā h' Upāli attabhāvo gambhīre gādhaṃ vindati.
an10.99:4.1: Atha āgaccheyya saso vā biḷāro vā.
an10.99:4.4: Yan nūnāhaṃ imaṃ udakarahadaṃ ogāhetvā kaṇṇasandhovikaṃ pi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷeyyaṃ, piṭṭhisandhovikaṃ pi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷeyyaṃ,
an10.99:4.5: kaṇṇasandhovikaṃ pi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷitvā piṭṭhisandhovikaṃ khiḍḍaṃ kiḷitvā nahātvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā yena kāmaṃ pakkameyyan' ti.
an10.99:4.6: So taṃ udakarahadaṃ sahasā appaṭisaṃkhāya pakkhandeyya.
an10.99:4.10: Paritto h' Upāli attabhāvo gambhīre gādhaṃ na vindati.
an10.99:4.11: Evam eva kho Upāli yo evaṃ vadeyya
an10.99:4.12: ‘ahaṃ samādhiṃ alabhamāno araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevissāmī' ti, tass' etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
an10.99:5.1: Seyyathā pi Upāli daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako sakena muttakarīsena kiḷati.
an10.99:6.1: Sa kho so Upāli kumāro aparena samayena vuddhim anvāya indriyānaṃ paripākam anvāya,
an10.99:6.2: yāni tāni kumārakānaṃ kiḷāpanakāni bhavanti, seyyathīdaṃ vaṅkaṃ ghaṭikaṃ mokkhacikaṃ ciṅgulakaṃ pattāḷhakaṃ rathakaṃ dhanukaṃ, tehi kiḷati.
an10.99:6.4: ‘nanvāyaṃ khiḍḍā purimāya khiḍḍāya abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā cā' ti?
an10.99:7.1: Sa kho so Upāli kumāro aparena samayena vuddhim anvāya indriyānaṃ paripākam anvāya
an10.99:7.3: cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi,
an10.99:7.7: kāyaviññeyyehi phoṭṭhabbehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi.
an10.99:7.9: ‘nanvāyaṃ khiḍḍā purimāhi khiḍḍāhi abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā cā' ti?
an10.99:8.1: Idha kho pana vo Upāli Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi Satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā.
an10.99:8.2: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
an10.99:8.3: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an10.99:9.1: Taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule paccājāto.
an10.99:9.2: So taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā Tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.
an10.99:9.3: So tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhati
an10.99:9.5: na yidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ;
an10.99:9.6: yan nūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan' ti.
an10.99:10.1: So aparena samayena appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
an10.99:11.1: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
an10.99:12.1: Adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharati.
an10.99:13.1: Abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī hoti, ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
an10.99:14.1: Musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa,
an10.99:15.1: pisunaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisunāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti; na ito sutvā amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya, amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya; iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
an10.99:16.1: Pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemaniyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
an10.99:17.1: Samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī, nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ.
an10.99:19.1: So santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena
an10.99:19.2: yena yen' eva pakkamati samādāy' eva pakkamati.
an10.99:19.3: Seyyathā pi nāma pakkhī sakuṇo yena yen' eva ḍeti sapattabhāro 'va ḍeti,
an10.99:19.4: evam eva bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena yena yen' eva pakkamati samādāy' eva pakkamati.
an10.99:19.5: So iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti. 6.
an10.99:20.1: So cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī,
an10.99:20.2: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
an10.99:20.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī,
an10.99:20.8: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
an10.99:20.9: So iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ avyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti. 7.
an10.99:21.1: So abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti, sammiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti, asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
an10.99:22.1: So iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato
an10.99:22.2: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
an10.99:22.3: So araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
an10.99:23.1: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati, abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti,
an10.99:23.2: vyāpādapadosaṃ pahāya avyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī, vyāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti,
an10.99:23.3: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno, thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti,
an10.99:23.4: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto, uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti,
an10.99:23.5: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti. 8.
an10.99:24.1: So ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
an10.99:24.2: vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an10.99:24.4: ‘nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā' ti?
an10.99:25.1: Imam pi kho Upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti, no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti. 9.
an10.99:26.1: Puna ca paraṃ Upāli bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā . . . dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an10.99:26.3: ‘nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā' ti?
an10.99:27.1: Imam pi kho Upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti, no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti. 10.
an10.99:28.1: Puna ca paraṃ Upāli bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā . . . tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an10.99:28.3: ‘nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā' ti?
an10.99:29.1: Imam pi kho Upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti, no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti. 11.
an10.99:30.1: Puna ca paraṃ Upāli bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā . . . catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Upāli ‘nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā' ti? Evaṃ bhante. Imam pi kho mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti, no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti. 12.
an10.99:31.1: Puna ca paraṃ Upāli bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso' ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an10.99:31.3: ‘nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā' ti?
an10.99:32.1: Imam pi kho Upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti, no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti. 13.
an10.99:33.1: Puna ca paraṃ Upāli bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇan' ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasamapajja viharati . . . pe . . .
an10.99:34.1: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī' ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati . . .
an10.99:35.1: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘santam etaṃ paṇītam etan' ti nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an10.99:35.3: ‘nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā' ti?
an10.99:36.1: Imam pi kho Upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti, no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti. 14.
an10.99:37.1: Puna ca paraṃ Upāli bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati, paññāya c' assa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.
an10.99:37.3: ‘nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā' ti?
an10.99:38.1: Imam pi kho Upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti, no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti.
an10.99:38.3: saṅghe te viharato phāsu bhavissatī ti. C. 1.
